body.statement: Can the handle in \(\mathrm{def:lower\text{-}handle}\) produce Borel laws \(P_{0,N},P_{1,N}\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{col}}\) for every sufficiently large \(N\), with \(\Gamma(P_{0,N})=\Gamma(0)\), \(\Gamma(P_{1,N})=\Gamma(s_N)\), \(s_N\asymp(\log N)^{-1}\), and \(\|P_{0,N}^{\otimes N}-P_{1,N}^{\otimes N}\|_{\mathrm{TV}}\to0\)? The construction must establish global density positivity, full-column-rank membership under the unit-variance source normalization, the common ray envelopes, the fixed eighth moment, greatest-divisor status in every direction, and the uniform weighted-Plancherel derivative bound for the six-degree Laplace--Student splice.
body.justification: This analytic construction is the genuine open content needed to make the causal logarithmic lower bound valid inside one fixed smooth moment class.
body.gap: Meister and Belomestny--Trabs--Tsybakov use Fourier compensation for scalar or covariance lower bounds, but their displayed pairs do not supply this moment-compatible causal collision path.
body.consumer: A positive answer activates the conditional Le Cam converse for uniformly honest whole-fiber procedures even when every compatible order has the same effect.
